title: HelpSteer3-Preference: Open Human-Annotated Preference Data across Diverse Tasks and Languages
paper_type_zh: 专家人工偏好数据、奖励模型与 RLHF
best_for_zh: 需要审计 LLM 后训练反馈、奖励或评测数据的研究者。
one_line: HelpSteer3-Preference is a CC-BY-4.0 human-annotated, multilingual and specialist preference dataset for reward modeling and RLHF.
发布 HelpSteer3-Preference 多任务、多语言人工偏好数据，扩展通用、STEM 与中文场景的奖励模型监督覆盖。
why: It specifies specialist recruitment, multi-annotator preference strength, disagreement filtering, multilingual coverage, and the release boundary needed to reuse preference data responsibly.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on human-annotated multilingual preference data with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: HelpSteer3-Preference addresses the fact that many open preference datasets are English-centric, lightly annotated, or dominated by one task type. It releases 40,476 human-annotated preference examples across diverse tasks and languages, so the data object is a prompt, competing responses, language/task metadata, and multiple human judgments—not a preference synthesized by a single teacher model.
HelpSteer3‑Preference 针对开放偏好集常以英语为中心、标注稀疏或被单一任务主导的问题。它发布 40,476 条人工标注的偏好样本，覆盖多类任务和语言；数据对象是提示、竞争回答、语言/任务元数据及多个人类判断，而不是由单一教师模型合成的偏好。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper’s key contribution is breadth with annotation redundancy: each item receives three to five annotations from a pool of more than 6,400 annotators in 77 countries. This makes disagreement a property to measure rather than discard. The release connects general instruction following, coding, multilingual evaluation, and other tasks in one preference set.
核心贡献是“广度加冗余标注”：每条样本由来自 77 个国家、超过 6,400 名标注者中的 3 至 5 人标注。分歧因此成为应测量的属性而非被丢弃的噪声。发布集把通用指令遵循、编程、多语种评估等任务放进一个偏好集合。

title: Method
方法
html: Responses come from 17 models; the collection covers 14 programming languages and 13 natural languages. The authors use multi-annotator aggregation to form preference labels and expose the data under CC-BY-4.0 on Hugging Face. A reproduction must retain language, task, model identity, individual/aggregated label policy, and split; turning all votes into one hard pair without recording disagreement loses the paper’s main signal.
回答来自 17 个模型，覆盖 14 种编程语言和 13 种自然语言。作者以多标注者聚合形成偏好标签，并在 Hugging Face 以 CC-BY-4.0 发布。复现必须保留语言、任务、模型身份、单人/聚合标签政策和切分；若把所有投票硬化为单个偏好对却不保留分歧，就丢失了论文最重要的信号。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates models trained with the release and analyzes how human labels vary across tasks and languages. Its evidence supports the claim that broad, redundant human annotation is viable at this scale; it does not show that the majority vote represents every locale or that all languages have equal coverage and quality.
论文评估了用该数据训练的模型，并分析人类标签如何随任务和语言变化。证据支持“大规模、广覆盖且有冗余的人类标注可行”，但不表示多数票代表每个地区，也不表示所有语言的覆盖度和质量相同。

title: Novelty
新意
html: HelpSteer3-Preference differs from synthetic preference mixtures by making human annotation, multilinguality, and multi-rater agreement first-class fields. The novel direction is not simply more data: it is a reusable measurement surface for plural and task-dependent preferences. It should be compared with HelpSteer2’s response-attribute ratings and with single-judge synthetic datasets.
与合成偏好混合不同，HelpSteer3‑Preference 把人工标注、多语种和多标注者一致性作为一等字段。新方向不只是更多数据，而是为多元且任务相关的偏好提供可复用测量表面；应与 HelpSteer2 的回答属性评分和单裁判合成集对照。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Country count is not demographic representativeness. Annotation instructions, translation, model-response style, and aggregation can erase minority preferences; lower-resource languages may have smaller or noisier slices. Check per-language counts, inter-rater agreement, tie policy, and whether code preferences are assessed by executable correctness or perceived quality.
国家数量不等于人口代表性。标注说明、翻译、模型回答文风和聚合方式都可能抹平少数偏好；低资源语言切片可能更少或更噪。应检查每种语言计数、标注者一致性、并列处理，并确认代码偏好是按可执行正确性还是主观质量评定。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it for multilingual reward modeling, preference-data audits, cross-task transfer studies, and experiments that need multiple human votes. It is valuable for testing whether a reward model transfers beyond English general chat. It should not be used as evidence that a model is culturally aligned without local evaluation.
适合多语种奖励建模、偏好数据审计、跨任务迁移研究，以及需要多个真人投票的实验；尤其可测试奖励模型是否能超越英语通用聊天。没有本地评估时，不能据此宣称模型实现了文化对齐。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the dataset card and preserve the exact revision. Report language/task/model strata, number of annotations used per item, aggregation method, discarded disagreements, license, and any translation or templating. Evaluate per language and per task before publishing a global mean.
阅读数据卡并固定版本。报告语言/任务/模型分层、每条样本使用的标注数、聚合方法、被丢弃的分歧、许可及翻译或模板化操作；先按语言和任务评测，再发布全局均值。
